name: Sapphire Strand
description: Cast a strand of deep blue force round an opponent's soul so that its movement slows.

name: Lapis Wrap
description: Wrap the user in a lapis-bright cord that dulls a soul-strike.

name: Cobalt Hitch
description: Hitch a cobalt line to a far soul and cross to it in one step.

name: Cobalt Lashing
description: Lash a cobalt cord across an opponent's soul so that the blow cuts deep and clings.

name: Lapis Gauge
description: Lay a lapis cord on a soul and gauge its strength and the strain it bears.

name: Cobalt Noose
description: Draw a cobalt noose closed on a soul and press down its force while it holds.

name: Sapphire Manacle
description: Close a manacle of sapphire force on an opponent's soul so that it can neither move nor gather force.

name: Manacle Surge
description: Surge the manacle's force inward so that the held soul is pressed down hard at once.

name: Sapphire Immurement
description: Wall an opponent's soul in sapphire cord so that no technique can leave it until the wall is broken.

name: Held Soul
description: Take an opponent's soul in a light hold so that it cannot range away.

name: Vigil Cord
description: Keep a vigil cord taut before the user that catches a soul-strike aimed at the user.

name: Anchor Hitch
description: Hitch to a post soul and swing across to a new stance in one step.

name: Wardens' Gauge
description: Gauge a held soul's resistance so that the warden knows how long the hold will keep.

name: Pressing Fetter
description: Set a fetter in rank on the held soul so that its force stays low as long as the fetter stands.

name: Shock Lashing
description: Lash the held soul against its post so that it takes a hard shock.

name: Standing Custody
description: Take a soul fully into custody and hold it fast against any struggle.

name: Custody Verdict
description: Pass sentence on the held soul with a single heavy crush of its force.

name: Warden's Seal
description: Set a warden's seal on a soul that shuts every technique it holds until the seal is lifted.

name: Guard Fetter
description: Close a guard fetter on an opponent's soul so that its next move comes slow.

name: Tempered Cinch
description: Cinch a tempered fetter before the user as a plate against a soul-strike.

name: Cinch Dash
description: Cinch a line to a far soul and dash along it in one quick pull.

name: Fetter Tap
description: Tap the fetter's weight against an opponent's soul so that a sharp knock follows.

name: Steel Gyve
description: Close a steel gyve on the soul and let it bear down on the soul's force.

name: Gyve Reading
description: Read through the gyve how firmly the held soul pulls and where it is weak.

name: Gyve Lash
description: Lash the gyve's chain across the soul so that a clean blow lands.

name: Stalwart Manacle
description: Hold a manacle on the soul that no strain can slacken.

name: Manacle Judgment
description: Drive the manacle's full weight in at once so that the held soul is flattened.

name: Warding Fetter
description: Catch a hostile binding on the fetter and turn it about so that it closes on the one who cast it.

name: Unbroken Strand
description: Hold a strand on an opponent's soul that does not part however the soul pulls.

name: Tether Plate
description: Beat the tether flat into a plate that bears a soul-lash.

name: Tether Glide
description: Glide along the tether to the far end in one smooth motion.

name: Tether Strum
description: Strum the tether so that a shiver of force runs into the soul on the other end.

name: Lasting Hold
description: Maintain a hold on a soul for a long span with little strain on the caster.

name: Strain Gauge
description: Read the strain along the tether and tell when the held soul is near to breaking it.

name: Anchored Tether
description: Anchor the line to the user's soul so that a soul-strike glances along it and off.

name: Endless Tether
description: Pay out a tether without end so that the held soul can flee but never reach its limit.

name: Tether Wrench
description: Wrench the tether hard so that the held soul is torn from its stance and pressed low.

name: Perpetual Tether
description: Cast a tether that renews itself every breath so that the hold lasts as long as the caster's will.

name: Stormwing Strand
description: Throw a strand on a quick stoop and close it on an opponent's soul.

name: Pinion Cord
description: Beat a cord like a pinion against a soul-bolt and fling it aside.

name: Raptor Hitch
description: Hitch to a soul and swoop across the gap in one stoop.

name: Talon Tug
description: Tug the cord's barbed end through an opponent's soul like a talon.

name: Wing Snare
description: Spread a snare wide as a wing and close it on a soul that moves into the shadow of the span.

name: Diving Fetter
description: Dive a fetter down onto an opponent from above so that it lands with its full weight.

name: Raptor Wrap
description: Wrap the user in cords that beat like wings against a soul-strike.

name: Stormwing Net
description: Cast a net on the gale and drop it over a group of souls so that each is held.

name: Rending Talons
description: Rake a spread of barbed cords across the field so that each soul they cross is torn.

name: Tempest Net
description: Cast a net of storm force over the whole field that presses every caught soul to the ground.

name: Spoken Bond
description: Speak a short pact and let it close as a bond on an opponent's soul.

name: Pledge Ward
description: Hold a pact before an ally so that a soul-strike aimed at them is stayed.

name: Bond Pace
description: Pull on a bond to an ally and arrive at their side in one pace.

name: Surety Tug
description: Tug the pact once and feel whether the other soul keeps its surety.

name: Witness Cord
description: Leave a witness cord on a soul to learn afterward every word and deed that soul gave.

name: Bonds Undone
description: Undo a bond laid on an ally against their will and let their soul move free.

name: Breaker's Gyve
description: Close a gyve on one who broke a pact and press down their force.

name: Pact Manacle
description: Hold a pact-manacle on the soul of an oath-breaker that tightens with each breach.

name: Pact Reckoning
description: Call in the whole weight of the pact at once on a soul that has defaulted.

name: Covenant Shackle
description: Close a shackle of covenant on a soul that shuts every technique it holds while the covenant stands.

name: Mesh Strand
description: Throw a strand of fine mesh over an opponent's soul so that it drags at its steps.

name: Mesh Screen
description: Hang a screen of mesh before the user that catches a soul-strike.

name: Mesh Hitch
description: Hitch the mesh to a far soul and be drawn across in one step.

name: Mesh Tap
description: Tap the mesh's weighted edge against an opponent's soul.

name: Mesh Reading
description: Spread the mesh wide and read every soul that touches it.

name: Hauling Net
description: Haul a caught soul in along the net into the user's reach.

name: Drifting Mesh
description: Let the mesh drift across an opponent's sense so that the opponent loses the true soul behind it.

name: Meshed Gyve
description: Close a gyve of mesh on a soul that presses its force low.

name: Wide Mesh
description: Spread the mesh wide over a crowd of souls and draw it in so that none can slip out.

name: Mesh Tightening
description: Draw the mesh tight in one pull so that every soul in it is squeezed.

name: Deep Mesh
description: Sink the mesh deep into the souls it holds and press each of them under its own weight.

name: Closing Knot
description: Tie a final knot on an opponent's soul that holds against a first pull.

name: Last Wrap
description: Wrap the last cord about the user so that a soul-strike falls on it.

name: Closing Hitch
description: Hitch the closing cord to a soul and ride its draw a pace.

name: Dying Cord
description: Let a dying cord snap against an opponent's soul with the last of its force.

name: Ending Reading
description: Read through a cord how near a soul stands to its end.

name: Terminal Knot
description: Draw a terminal knot that settles on the soul's force and holds it low.

name: Unraveling Strand
description: Pull a strand through an opponent's forming technique and unravel it.

name: Loose Ends
description: Gather the loose ends of a binding and pull them out of an ally's soul.

name: Endless Knot
description: Tie a knot that has no end to untie and hold a soul in it without relief.

name: Knot Foundering
description: Collapse every knot at once so that the held soul is pressed flat.

name: Last Knot
description: Tie the last knot on a soul so that it is held and sealed against every release but its caster's.
